thread:
Jane: Quick heads-up — running a 45m wargame at 10am tomorrow to finalize the competitive hooks for launch. Goal: produce 3 SDR-ready soundbites and 1 benchmark claim we can defend. Who's in? :crossed_swords:
Mike: I'll be there. Want to surface the latency/cost delta vs cloud endpoints and managed LLM APIs — that's where our narrative lands.
Tara: count me, I can bring the recent P50/P95 graphs + staging tail-case notes.
Alex: I'll draft a one-pager rebut map vs infra vendors (quantization, dedicated capacity, private deployment, SLA tradeoffs).
Leo: For SDR copy — prefer 2-line opener + 1-line objection response. Example:
  SDR: "Need predictable latency and lower per-token cost for chat at scale?"
  Objection: "We already use CloudVendorX" -> "They scale, but we reduce per-token cost by batching/caching and give a unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
Mike: Can we include a quick benchmark callout: "~4–6x lower unit cost at comparable latency" — is that defensible without QA sign-off?
Tara: Need to be careful. From last bench: at 512 tokens, CloudVendorX median ~120ms, our tuned config ~18ms single-stream on a comparable GPU. Cost numbers vary with quantization and batching. Don't publish multipliers until revenue bench and QA verify.
Jane: Action items: Tara -> surface P50/P95 and preliminary cost calc; Alex -> draft SDR lines + rebut snippets; Mike -> run a focused latency+cost bench on canary model; Sarah -> prep webinar hook (30m) that ties to the claim. I'll collate post-wargame.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent for 10:00–10:45 tomorrow to #marketing.
Sarah: Webinar hook idea: "Serving-first: predictability beats peak demos" — show routing policies, dedicated tier benefits, and graceful fallbacks in a 3-step demo.
Alex: Also propose a 1-pager: 'When to choose Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private' for field with 3 quick criteria each.
Jane: For inbound routing: if demo request mentions "latency", "SLA", "dedicated", or "private" -> tag to sales-enterprise queue. Otherwise, route to inbound-growth.
Mike: Regex for tracking form: /latency|SLA|dedicated|private|throughput/i — should we include "throughput"?
Tara: Yes include throughput. I'll attach the graphs and a short quantization explainer to the doc before noon. Also adding raw bench CSVs for validation.
Leo: For SDR soundbites, propose 3 variants:
  1) PLG opener: "Reduce chat cost and keep token-level latency predictable — ask about our Dedicated plan."
  2) Enterprise opener: "Need SLA-backed inference with private deployments? We run mirrored runtimes across modes."
  3) Tech opener: "Batching, KV caching, and quant-friendly kernels cut unit cost without sacrificing latency."
Jane: We'll run these in the playtest — one-liners only, then iterate. After the wargame we'll push the finalized snippets + rebut sheet to SDRs and the sales playbook. :thumbsup: 
Mike: One more: let's avoid absolute claims like "always cheaper". Use comparative language and link to the benchmark appendix.
Jane: Agreed. Meeting notes and pre-read here: https://notion.company/redwood/wargame-7201234567 — add your attachments. See you all tomorrow.
Sarah: Will seed webinar landing copy and a signup gating question to capture SLA/latency interest.
Alex: I'll draft the rebut matrix and share a 1-slide cheat for demos.
Tara: Uploading charts now.
Jane: Thanks team — align after the wargame and plan a quick sync with SDR ops to roll the playbook on Friday.
_meta: thread generated for marketing wargame playtest — competitive messaging vs cloud ai platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors
